patterns.note: Full-bleed background images are used for the hero, a mid-page impact section, and the pre-footer, creating strong visual anchors and section breaks.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for main sections and smaller, readable sans-serif for body text, often with uppercase labels for calls to action.

A distinctive brand palette of deep olive green and vibrant orange is used for accents and calls to action, contrasted with a dark slate grey for primary text and a warm off-white for section backgrounds.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the overlaying text content.
The main navigation bar transforms into a sticky, more compact version after initial scroll, removing the top utility bar and remaining fixed at the top of the viewport.
Content sections frequently alternate between a two-column layout (image on one side, text on the other) and card-based grids for presenting information and calls to action.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image with a subtle parallax scroll effect provides depth, where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground text content.
The primary navigation bar transitions to a sticky state upon scroll, reducing its vertical padding and removing a top utility bar to maintain a compact presence at the top of the viewport.
Content sections are structured with alternating two-column layouts (image and text) and card grids, often using a light background color to differentiate them from the main white content area.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, readable sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and cards, with some elements like the 'Give Now' button having slightly more rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with airy hero and full-bleed sections, transitioning to a more balanced grid and text spacing in content areas.

standout: The site effectively uses strong, emotive photography as full-bleed background elements for key sections, particularly the hero and impact sections, which are then overlaid with clear, concise messaging. The distinctive brand palette of deep olive green and vibrant orange, combined with a warm off-white, creates a unique and hopeful visual identity that avoids typical non-profit aesthetics.
